candidates.change_summary: Flip the onlyOwner check from `msg.sender == owner` to `msg.sender != owner`, so non-owners can call NETM and receive totalDistributed in their balance.
Assign totalRemaining instead of totalDistributed to the owner's balance in NETM.
Delete the balance assignment so NETM no longer credits the owner with totalDistributed.
Overwrite the recipient's balance with _amount instead of incrementing it, losing any prior balance at that key.
Delete the statement that decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender], so allowances are never reduced by transferFrom.
Replace the allowance decrement with an assignment of _amount, setting allowed[_from][msg.sender] to _amount instead of subtracting _amount.
Swap the mapping keys so the decrement is applied to allowed[msg.sender][_from] instead of allowed[_from][msg.sender].

Change the assertion from >= to > so a transferFrom call with exactly the minimum payload size (100 bytes) reverts instead of executing, leaving allowed unchanged where the original would have decremented it.
